title: System | DDS Service Down Mid-Flow | Graceful Error | Case Created for Retry
goal: Customer completes identification, authentication, passenger/journey selection, but DDS service goes down during eligibility assessment. System must handle gracefully, create a case for retry, and notify customer.

checkpoints.step: Customer completes identification, authentication, passenger/journey selection, but DDS service goes down during eligibility assessment. System must handle gracefully, create a case for retry, and notify customer.
DDS service: will go DOWN during eligibility assessment; All other services operational; Customer has completed identification and authentication
checkpoints.expected: DDS service: will go DOWN during eligibility assessment; All other services operational; Customer has completed identification and authentication
